description: This file defines the ImmersiveModeFragment class, an Android fragment that manages immersive mode UI toggling, including handling system UI visibility and user interaction logic.

classes.name: ImmersiveModeFragment
classes.description: An Android fragment that provides immersive mode toggling functionality, managing system UI visibility states.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the fragment, indicating it has options menu items.

methods.name: onActivityCreated
methods.description: Sets up a listener to log height changes when system UI visibility changes.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections, toggling immersive mode when specific menu item is chosen.

methods.name: toggleHideyBar
methods.description: Toggles immersive mode (hide/show system UI elements) based on current UI visibility flags and Android SDK version.
